## Problem statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe what the problem is.
Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Scope and impact

- Does this add a third-party dependency? (This project currently uses only the standard library.)
- Does this change the environment variables listed in `.env.example`?
- Is this a breaking change?

## Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
